
### summary: text
--- Text
{{ $values['summary'] ?? '' }}
--- Only when it is set
@if (! empty($values['summary']))
@endif

### notes: text
--- Text
{{ $values['notes'] ?? '' }}
--- Only when it is set
@if (! empty($values['notes']))
@endif

### body: html
--- Rich text
{!! $values['body'] ?? '' !!}
--- Only when it is set
@if (! empty($values['body']))
@endif

### price: number
--- Text
{{ $values['price'] ?? '' }}
--- Only when it is set
@if (! empty($values['price']))
@endif

### featured: bool
--- Only when it is on
@if (! empty($values['featured']))
@endif
--- Only when it is off
@if (! ($values['featured'] ?? false))
@endif

### colour: text
--- Text
{{ $values['colour'] ?? '' }}
--- Only when it is set
@if (! empty($values['colour']))
@endif

### sizes: list<text>
--- All of them, with commas
{{ implode(', ', (array) ($values['sizes'] ?? [])) }}
--- Each one, in a loop
@foreach ($values['sizes'] ?? [] as $size)
    {{ $size }}
@endforeach
--- Only when there are any
@if (collect($values['sizes'] ?? [])->isNotEmpty())
@endif

### made_on: date
--- Date
{{ ($values['made_on'] ?? null)?->translatedFormat('j F Y') }}
--- Only when it is set
@if (! empty($values['made_on']))
@endif

### more: link
--- Link
@if (($more = $values['more'] ?? null) && ! empty($more['url']))
    <a href="{{ $more['url'] }}" @if (! empty($more['new_tab'])) target="_blank" rel="noopener" @endif>{{ $more['label'] ?? $more['title'] ?? $more['url'] }}</a>
@endif
--- Only when it is set
@if (! empty($values['more']))
@endif

### cover: asset
--- Image
@if ($cover = $values['cover'] ?? null)
    <img src="{{ $cover->url('large') }}" alt="{{ $cover->altIn() }}">
@endif
--- Link to the file
@if ($cover = $values['cover'] ?? null)
    <a href="{{ $cover->url() }}">{{ $cover->title ?: $cover->filename }}</a>
@endif
--- Only when it is set
@if (! empty($values['cover']))
@endif

### photos: list<asset>
--- Each one, in a loop
@foreach ($values['photos'] ?? [] as $photo)
    <img src="{{ $photo->url('large') }}" alt="{{ $photo->altIn() }}">
@endforeach
--- Only when there are any
@if (collect($values['photos'] ?? [])->isNotEmpty())
@endif

### related: list<entry(articles)>
--- Each one, in a loop
@foreach ($values['related'] ?? [] as $article)
    <a href="{{ $article->url() }}">{{ $article->title }}</a>
@endforeach
--- Only when there are any
@if (collect($values['related'] ?? [])->isNotEmpty())
@endif

### see_also: list<entry(articles|pages)>
--- Each one, in a loop
@foreach ($values['see_also'] ?? [] as $item)
    <a href="{{ $item->url() }}">{{ $item->title }}</a>
@endforeach
--- Only when there are any
@if (collect($values['see_also'] ?? [])->isNotEmpty())
@endif

### mentor: entry(articles)
--- Only when it is set
@if (! empty($values['mentor']))
@endif

### topics: list<term(topics)>
--- Each one, in a loop
@foreach ($values['topics'] ?? [] as $topic)
    <a href="{{ $topic->url() }}">{{ $topic->title() }}</a>
@endforeach
--- Only when there are any
@if (collect($values['topics'] ?? [])->isNotEmpty())
@endif

### details: group{material, weight, picture}

### steps: list<row{label, text, icon}>
--- Each one, in a loop
@foreach ($values['steps'] ?? [] as $step)
    <div>
        {{ $step['label'] ?? '' }}
        {!! $step['text'] ?? '' !!}
        @if ($icon = $step['icon'] ?? null)
            <img src="{{ $icon->url('large') }}" alt="{{ $icon->altIn() }}">
        @endif
    </div>
@endforeach
--- Only when there are any
@if (collect($values['steps'] ?? [])->isNotEmpty())
@endif

### sections: list<block(hero|text|cta)>
--- Each block, drawn by its own template
@foreach ($values['sections'] ?? [] as $section)
    @includeFirst(['cms.blocks.'.$section->type, 'cms.partials.block'], ['block' => $section])
@endforeach
--- Only when there are any
@if (collect($values['sections'] ?? [])->isNotEmpty())
@endif

### title: text
--- Text
{{ $entry->title }}
--- Only when it is set
@if ($entry->title)
@endif

### url: text
--- Text
{{ $entry->url() }}
--- Only when it is set
@if ($entry->url())
@endif

### published_at: date
--- Date
{{ $entry->published_at?->translatedFormat('j F Y') }}
--- Only when it is set
@if ($entry->published_at)
@endif

### slug: text
--- Text
{{ $entry->slug }}
--- Only when it is set
@if ($entry->slug)
@endif
